title: Cancer Free — EN/IT/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: acoustic folk fingerpicked guitar Italian Portuguese language learning quiet warm baritone 96bpm gentle brushed drums trilingual true story family relief intimate
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
May 2022. Six words.
Cancer free. Joel texted. Corey answered.
The most important fact of that year.
Cancer free.

[Verse 2 - Italian, with English translations]
Maggio 2022. Sei parole. (May 2022. Six words.)
Kerry aveva ricevuto la chiamata ieri dal medico ed è libera dal cancro. (Kerry had the call yesterday from the doctor and she is cancer free.)
Joel ha inviato sei parole. Che erano tutta la storia. (Joel sent six words. That were the whole story.)
Libera dal cancro. (Cancer free.)
Il tipo di lettura che fai due volte (The kind of reading you do twice)
Prima di lasciare che sia vero. (Before you let it be true.)

[Chorus - Portuguese, with English translations]
Livre do câncer (Cancer free)
Kerry (Kerry)
Livre do câncer (Cancer free)
A chamada chegou (The call came through)
Livre do câncer (Cancer free)
A palavra que o médico usou (The word the doctor used)
Livre do câncer (Cancer free)
Joel enviou seis palavras (Joel sent six words)
Que eram toda a história (That were the whole story)
Livre do câncer — Kerry (Cancer free — Kerry)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The rest is private. The fact is for everyone. Cancer free.
Italian: Il resto è privato. Il fatto è per tutti. Libera dal cancro. (The rest is private. The fact is for everyone. Cancer free.)
Portuguese: O resto é privado. O fato é para todos. Livre do câncer. (The rest is private. The fact is for everyone. Cancer free.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Awesome. Good. Cancer free.
Italian: Meraviglioso. Bene. Libera dal cancro. (Awesome. Good. Cancer free.)
Portuguese: Incrível. Bom. Livre do câncer. (Awesome. Good. Cancer free.)
